scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with finite independent reproducibility checks. scientific_limitations: Odd system sizes; exactly coherent noninteracting qubits, instantaneous perfect majority-conditioned common Poisson resets; fixed subcritical detuning or fixed critical-window parameter with fixed Rabi norm; first-switch observable rather than unrestricted mixing. No uniform large-crossover-parameter limit or realistic noise model.
title: Sharp exponential-to-quartic switching crossover in a majority-reset Rabi ensemble
